card.name: Words just before a metabolic process
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words such as inhibit, shorten, interferes with, and 'markers of' that come right before a body process (metabolism, glucuronidation, hemostasis, half-life). Seen in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Verb of interference
modes.description: A verb or its partner word saying one drug alters another drug's handling, right before the process named.

modes.description: The word 'of' after 'biochemical markers' and before a body process.

card.writes: It pushes toward rare or unrelated nouns and away from category words like genre, category and sector, so it does not seem to add anything clear.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says one drug affects how the body processes something, just before the process is named.
